schema_version: 1
source_of_truth: docs/http-and-websocket.md
base_path_default: /api/v1
routes:
  - POST /api/v1/stat/session/start
  - POST /api/v1/stat/events
  - GET /api/v1/stat/summary/task/:task_id
  - GET /api/v1/stat/summary/tasks
  - GET /api/v1/stat/summary/session/:session_id
  - GET /ws/v1/stat/events
  - GET /internal/health
  - GET /internal/v1/students/:student_id/learning-sessions/:session_id/summary
identity:
  required_headers: [X-User-Id, X-User-Role]
  optional_header: X-Language
  verification: none_in_service
internal_identity:
  header: X-Internal-Token
  route_absent_when_empty: true
websocket:
  messages: [session_start, events_batch]
  origin_policy: allow_all
  authentication: upgrade_headers_only
responses:
  envelope: data
  error_envelope: error_and_trace_id
